summary.storyTitle: Story 3: Turn Construction and Recovery Cascade
summary.implementedScope: Resolved SV-03-001 by making recovery write-back update only pending/failed rows, so an already-ready worker result survives a late floor persistence attempt. Resolved SV-03-002 by adding focused Story 3 coverage for TC-3.2c, TC-3.4a, TC-3.5a, plus the TC-3.8d ready-row race. TC-3.7a evidence remains the turn-cascade test that opens BEGIN IMMEDIATE inside provider recovery and asserts probeAcquired true, proving provider recovery runs outside the completion write transaction.
